single_vitb32.approach: Single image: CLIP ViT-B-32 + colour + area id, logistic regression

single_vitb16.approach: Single image: CLIP ViT-B-16 + colour + area id, logistic regression

single_ref_vitb16.approach: Single image + labelled training crops of the same area as references

agents_single_photo.approach: Agents' pipeline, each photo on its own

agents_single_photo_andre_labels.approach: Agents' pipeline, each photo on its own

agents_9models_same_day.approach: Agents' pipeline, 9-model stock average, uses same-day photos
agents_9models_same_day.seconds: stock ≈ 2.4 GPU (2.6 GB VRAM) or up to ≈ 195 CPU, plus the product check

agents_9models_single_photo.approach: Agents' pipeline, 9-model stock average, each photo on its own
agents_9models_single_photo.seconds: stock ≈ 2.4 GPU (2.6 GB VRAM) or up to ≈ 195 CPU, plus the product check

agents_same_day_3heads.approach: Agents' pipeline + 3rd stock head, uses same-day photos

agents_single_photo_3heads.approach: Agents' pipeline + 3rd stock head, each photo on its own

single_blend_vitb32.approach: Single image: CLIP ViT-B-32 + colour + area id, logistic regression + gradient boosting blend

lab_image_only.approach: Single image: pixel features of the area and its crate + logistic and tree blend, product check against a bank of training crops
lab_image_only.seconds: being measured; features about 0.1 s per photo on 1 CPU thread (partial), no GPU, no CLIP

combo_dinob_stock_clip_product.approach: Combined: stock from André's fine-tuned DINOv2-base, product check from Miguel's CLIP model

combo_dinos_stock_clip_product.approach: Combined, cheap: stock from André's fine-tuned DINOv2-small, product check from Miguel's CLIP model

combo_dinos_stock_lab_product.approach: Combined, cheaper: stock from André's fine-tuned DINOv2-small, product check from the lab's image-only model (HSV bank of training crops)
combo_dinos_stock_lab_product.seconds: about 0.9 CPU (stock 0.9 + product 0.01, product measured on a loaded machine)

lab_image_only_ensemble.approach: Single image, no CLIP: weighted average of three lab stock models (pixel features, slot references, a small fine-tuned MobileNetV3) + product check against a bank of training crops
lab_image_only_ensemble.seconds: about 0.2 CPU, 2 threads, measured on a loaded laptop; no GPU

agents_finetuned_b_same_day.approach: Agents' pipeline, fine-tuned DINOv2-base stock (2 seeds), uses same-day photos

agents_finetuned_b_single_photo.approach: Agents' pipeline, fine-tuned DINOv2-base stock (2 seeds), each photo on its own

agents_finetuned_s_same_day.approach: Agents' pipeline, fine-tuned DINOv2-small stock, uses same-day photos

agents_finetuned_s_single_photo.approach: Agents' pipeline, fine-tuned DINOv2-small stock, each photo on its own

agents_img_one_pass.approach: Agents, image only, ONE DINOv2-small pass: product from frozen block 8, stock from the fine-tuned blocks

agents_img_ftB2.approach: Agents, image only: product head on frozen DINOv2-small + fine-tuned DINOv2-base stock (2 seeds)

agents_img_ftS.approach: Agents, image only: product head on frozen DINOv2-small + fine-tuned DINOv2-small stock (two passes)

agents_img_frozen_S.approach: Agents, image only: frozen DINOv2-small with a product head and a stock head
